1.title: Welcome to the Quest Installer
1.intro: Follow these steps to install ScoreSaber on Quest for Beat Saber

2.title: Sign in

4.title: Installation
4.intro: This guide assumes you are using <mbf>MBF</mbf> to mod your game
4.connect: Connect your Quest to your PC or phone and open MBF
4.addMods: Click Connect to Quest and select your Quest in the popup that follows. You should see the following screen (you may need to press Add Mods first):
4.upload: Use the Upload Files button to upload the ScoreSaber .qmod you just downloaded
4.finish: Once it finishes installing you should be good to go!
